questions: This English singer-songwriter won the BRITs Critics' Choice Award for his 2012 debut EP and an Ivor Novello for Songwriter of the Year in 2014, later releasing albums including Wrong Crowd and Jubilee Road — who is he?
Tom Odell (born 24 November 1990) is an English singer-songwriter.
Fuji Television is headquartered in which country?
Fuji Television: Japanese television station in Tokyo.
In which country was Bahmani Kingdom?
Bahmani Kingdom: India. The Bahmani Kingdom, or the Bahmani Sultanate, was a late medieval Persianate kingdom that ruled the Deccan Plateau in India.
Home to Carl Zeiss and a university founded in 1558, this German city has been a world centre of the optical industry for most of the 20th century — which city?
Jena: City in Germany. Jena (German: [ˈjeːna]) is a city in Germany and the second largest city in Thuringia.
Known also as yoke elm, this species of hornbeam native to Western Asia and Europe grows only up to elevations of about 1,000 metres — which species?
Carpinus betulus: Species of tree. It requires a warm climate for good growth, and occurs only at elevations up to 1,000 metres (3,300 ft).

This pastor led Atlanta's First Baptist Church for 49 years and founded a media ministry that broadcasts his sermons worldwide, while also serving two terms as president of the Southern Baptist Convention — who is he?
Charles Stanley: American pastor and televangelist (1932–2023)
